attributes.title: WSAAI 64th Annual Scientific Session
attributes.venue: Four Seasons O'ahu at Ko Olina
attributes.cme_provider: American College of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
attributes.organizer: Western Society of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology
attributes.summary:
Expect long days at this Hawaii meeting: on Tuesday the preliminary agenda runs into the late afternoon, so do not assume free afternoons. It runs January 24 to 28, 2027, and topics include non-IgE drug hypersensitivity and drug allergy diagnostics.

The activity is jointly provided with ACAAI for up to 21 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits. Registration is $450 for members, $600 for nonmembers and $225 for nurses and allied health staff. The resort room block has sold out, so ask the registration contact about nearby hotels before you book.
